name: Blockstream Satellite API
what_it_is: A Lightning app (Lapp) built on c-lightning that exposes a RESTful API for submitting messages to be broadcast globally over the Blockstream Satellite network, with payments handled via Bitcoin Lightning Network. It pairs an API server with a transmitter daemon that dequeues paid messages and coordinates satellite transmissions.
components: api-server (Ruby/Sinatra REST API, handles order creation and Lightning Charge payment callbacks)
workers (transmitter daemon, dequeues paid messages and coordinates satellite transmissions)
sse-server (Server-Sent Events server for real-time subscription to transmission events)
blc (Bitcoin Lightning Charge stack combining c-lightning and lightning-charge for payment processing)
redis (message queue backing store shared by api-server, workers, and sse-server)
proxy_server (nginx reverse proxy exposing port 8080, routes to api-server and sse-server)
protocols: Lightning Network (Bitcoin micropayments via lightning-charge / c-lightning)
DVB-S2 (satellite transmission protocol used by Blockstream Satellite)
Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time transmission status subscriptions
Redis pub/sub (internal message passing between api-server, workers, and sse-server)
measurement: bid_per_byte (millisatoshis per byte, must meet minimum threshold or BID_TOO_SMALL error is returned)
configuration: CHARGE_ROOT: URL to lightning-charge instance including API token (e.g. http://api-token:<token>@blc:9112)
CHARGE_API_TOKEN: shared secret for authenticating with lightning-charge
CALLBACK_URI_ROOT: base URI lightning-charge uses to post payment callbacks back to the API server
SUB_CHANNELS: comma-separated SSE channels to subscribe to (transmissions, gossip, btc-src, auth)
fault_injection: BID_TOO_SMALL (error 102): bid is below the minimum millisatoshis-per-byte threshold
MESSAGE_FILE_TOO_SMALL (error 117): uploaded message is below minimum size
MESSAGE_FILE_TOO_LARGE (error 118): uploaded message exceeds maximum size
MESSAGE_MISSING (error 126): neither message string nor file upload provided
ORDER_CHANNEL_UNAUTHORIZED_OP (error 130): operation not permitted on this order's channel
INVALID_AUTH_TOKEN (error 109): auth_token does not match the order
ORDER_NOT_FOUND (error 104): no order exists for the given UUID
ORDER_CANCELLATION_ERROR (error 120): order could not be cancelled
SEQUENCE_NUMBER_NOT_FOUND (error 114): no transmitted message exists for the given sequence number
modes: pending: order created, awaiting Lightning invoice payment
paid: invoice paid, order queued for satellite transmission
confirming: transmission nearly complete, awaiting confirmation
queued: combined view of paid + transmitting + confirming orders
rx-pending: transmitted but awaiting Rx confirmations from satellite receivers
retransmitting: retransmission in progress for one or more regions
received: fully transmitted and confirmed received in all targeted regions
docker_services: blc (shesek/lightning-charge:0.4.23) — Lightning Charge + c-lightning payment node, volume: blc
api-server (build: server/) — REST API, depends on blc, volume: data
workers (build: server/, cmd: workers.sh) — transmitter daemon, depends on api-server + redis, volume: data
sse-server (build: sse/) — SSE event server, depends on api-server + redis
redis (redis:latest) — message queue, no persistent volume
proxy_server (build: nginx/) — nginx reverse proxy, exposes host port 8080 → container port 80, depends on api-server + sse-server
notable_absences: No actual DVB-S2 satellite hardware or SDR transmitter is included in docker-compose; physical satellite uplink is external to this stack
No authentication or rate limiting on the public REST endpoints (Flask-Limiter noted as future work)
No fiat currency pricing support (noted as future work)
No TLS termination in the provided nginx config (proxy listens on plain HTTP port 80/8080)
No persistent volume for Redis, so queue state is lost on container restart
